content_sections.body: Prepare a two-turn exchange about making a study timetable. Give the main detail, listen to one follow-up, and answer it clearly. Use this model as support: 'I am going to finish my homework first, then I am going to call my study partner.' The exchange should meet this lesson goal: Organize a short exchange about study and future plans.
content_sections.title: Use it in a practical exchange (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about making a study timetable. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Organize a short exchange about study and future plans.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about making a study timetable without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
content_sections.title: Independent response (6 minutes)

constraints: Name the learner and tutor roles before the first turn.

speaking.instruction: Roleplay making a study timetable. Learner role: explain the situation and give one useful detail. Tutor role: be a helpful listener, ask one specific follow-up, and confirm the next step. Begin with a natural greeting and finish once both roles agree on the next action.

constraints: Wait for the learner draft before giving feedback.
